rows.detail: Manifest and report slot_id must be height_difference_3.
AAYS_TASK_ID must equal the Priority-2 task ID.
Origin must identify cagdascagdas100/chat_gpt_clone_1.
git rev-parse --show-toplevel must resolve to AAYS_REPO_ROOT.
main is an allowed runner checkout branch.
codex/aays-single-runner-v5-20260706 is allowed.
Detached HEAD is recorded and allowed for immutable checkout execution.
Any unrelated branch is rejected before network access.
AAYS_REPO_ROOT must be an existing directory.
The checkout must contain Git worktree metadata.
Git executable must resolve locally.
Windows PowerShell or PowerShell must resolve locally.
The executing Python interpreter must be resolvable.
Python version must be at least 3.10.
The checkout filesystem must expose at least 2147483648 free bytes.
Preflight itself performs no network request.
Manifest duplicate keys are rejected at every nesting level.
NaN in a manifest is rejected.
Positive and negative infinity are rejected.
Reports cannot serialize non-standard non-finite numbers.
Runner and website reports use same-directory temporary files and atomic replacement.
Exactly 18 immutable script or retry-manifest files are checked.
Each required checked-out file is hashed through git hash-object.
Each working-tree blob must equal its expected Git blob SHA.
Every expected object must exist as a Git blob.
The preflight manifest does not pin the mutable recovery template that pins the manifest.
Preflight completes and is accepted before the child chain starts.
Preflight output must be newly written for the current run.
Preflight is bounded at 180 seconds by default.
The complete existing child chain is bounded at 5700 seconds.
Timeout initiates child process-tree termination.
Captured process text is capped before report serialization.
Priority-2 task and recovery template are identical schema-12 blobs.
All three recovery tasks pin the schema-12 template and outer wrapper.
A false-done retry cannot restore the old direct v1 task template.
Preflight and watchdog outputs remain non-final with zero business rows.
